brief:
A young man from Gaza had aspired to study abroad and build a life beyond the territory, We Are Not Numbers reported. The ongoing conflict has derailed those plans, leaving his future uncertain as the war continues to reshape possibilities for Palestinians in the Gaza Strip.

The story reflects broader challenges faced by Gaza's youth, whose educational and professional aspirations have been upended by the military operations and humanitarian crisis gripping the territory. Many young Palestinians have seen opportunities for advancement and international experience effectively disappear in the wake of the conflict.
dek: A young man’s dream of studying abroad and experiencing life beyond Gaza is shattered by war.
title: War shatters young Palestinian's dream of studying abroad.
